projects.name: Campus in a rack (senior project)
projects.description: Built a three-building campus network using six real Cisco 2960 and 3560 switches and three ISR routers, configured via console. Separated students, staff, and security cameras into distinct broadcast domains connected only through the distribution layer. Subnetted a /22 into blocks for 11 departments with recorded allocations. Configured a link-state routing protocol in a single backbone area across three routers and verified failover under 10 seconds after unplugging a link. Produced a topology diagram and port-by-port cabling sheet still used by the lab.

projects.name: Guest Wi-Fi for the college open day
projects.description: Set up two access points with a separate visitor network and selected non-overlapping channels after conducting a walkthrough with a phone-based wireless analyser.

projects.name: Why is Lab 3 slow?
projects.description: Captured traffic on the lab uplink using packet analysis tools, identified a PC flooding the segment with broadcast frames due to a faulty network card, and disabled its port until the card was replaced.
